import pytest


def test_is_equal_to_sum_even():
    # Even numbers >= 8 should return True
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(8) == True
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(10) == True
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(12) == True
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(100) == True

    # Even numbers < 8 should return False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(0) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(2) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(4) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(6) == False

    # Odd numbers should return False regardless of size
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(7) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(9) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(11) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(99) == False

    # Negative numbers should return False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(-8) == False
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(-2) == False

    # Edge case: exactly 8 is the smallest valid value
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(8) == True
    assert is_equal_to_sum_even(7) == False
